experiment: Extension: broader microscopy dataset (MedMNIST+ BloodMNIST and PathMNIST, 64x64)
relation_to_onion_study: separate experiment; reuses the onion simulation, DGI, U-Net, training recipe, seeds policy and pass rule unchanged except where listed under deviations. The frozen onion Phase 1 / Phase 2 files are read-only (FREEZE_MANIFEST_phase1_phase2.md5 checked before/after).
claim_scope: fewer simulated, noise-free measurement shots; no photon-dose, biological-effect, hardware or quantum claim. DGI-10000 is a study-specific benchmark, not ground truth.

sampling.stratified_by: class label within each official split

data.conversion: uint8 sRGB -> linear (IEC 61966-2-1) -> Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B -> clip [0,1]; 64x64 as provided
data.splits: MedMNIST official train / val / test (PathMNIST test = CRC-VAL-HE-7K, a different centre from its train/val NCT-CRC-HE-100K)

simulation.nesting: DGI-N uses the first N shots of the same 10,000-shot sequence

training.images: 7,000 training images (3,500 blood + 3,500 path); one model per N and target, trained on both subsets
training.sequences: pool of K = 32 independent sequences per training image; seed = 30,000,000 + 10,000*k + train_index; one realisation per image per epoch via default_rng([0, epoch])

targets.clean: original clean object (models AI-original-N; as onion Phase 2)
targets.dgi10k: DGI-10000 of the same acquisition (models AI-N; as onion Phase 1)

training.selection: 1,000 validation images x shared sequences [2040, 2041, 2042]; checkpoint = lowest selection MSE

evaluation.test_pairs: 2,000 test images x 4 sequences = 8,000 (4,000 per subset)

clean_target.comparator: conventional DGI-10000 of the same sequence

methods: smoothed DGI-N (Gaussian sigma tuned on training pool k=0,1)
dgi10k_target.context: every image also scored against the clean object

metrics: edge r (Pearson r of Sobel magnitude maps)

criterion.definition: on paired image-level differences [metric(method) - metric(comparator)] pooled over seeds 2026-2029, the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples over images, seeds kept together, rng default_rng(0) per group) is >= -0.02 for SSIM AND >= -0.01 for Pearson r
criterion.minimum_N: smallest N in {500, 1000, 2000, 5000} meeting the criterion; reduction factor = 10000 / N
criterion.secondary: blood and path separately (same rule, images of that subset only)

order_of_work: validation evaluation -> freeze checkpoints (MD5) in results/target_*/frozen_for_test.json
single test evaluation per target (script refuses a second run)
deviations_from_onion: dataset: MedMNIST+ blood smears and H&E tissue instead of onion; images are already 64x64, so no centre crop or area downsampling
pool seed rule 30,000,000 + 10,000*k + i (onion 20,000,000 + 1000*k + i would collide for i >= 1000)
training on GPU with deterministic algorithms (onion: CPU); not bit-identical to CPU training
an epoch has 7,000 images (onion 341), so 80 epochs is ~20x more gradient steps
duplicate screening vectorised; same thresholds as src/dataset_audit_full.py, NCC for flips taken at the best pHash transform
near-blank images (object std < 0.005) excluded before the final draw
